caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, tapestry space, a rider on a dark horse passing through a field of leaping flames, rows of attendants watching from a striped tent canopy above, gold flames repeated as ornament over a pale ground, cinnabar red, gold, lapis blue, malachite green, jade white
notes_zh: 《Siyavush 火审》(Commons PD, Safavid 16世纪后半)：骑者穿越火海，条纹帐幕下观众成列。
